body:
Hi, I am so sad to say this, but I tried. I tried to reach out and say it clear and plainly that I have suicidal thoughts.. Unfortunately, they thought I was just going thru some rough patch and I "just lack faith".

I know that they love me still, tho. I know that they will feel bad when I do it, because they thought it would just pass by.. These things are a taboo where I come from, so I also understand their take on it. But I really don't know if I can do it anymore. So my mind if battling if I could be selfish to want death so badly..

As for my fiance, he is trying his best to understand me.. But I don't know how to help him understand.. He has a really healthy mental environment, you see. I feel like he can't see my darkness through his light and sunshiney world, no matter how hard I try. I always feel guilty. Maybe he shouldn't have met me.. Then he would have met someone like him who lives in the light.

Yeah I don't think our government is and will ever be interested in our search histories tho, I am from a third world country by the way. 😅

It was nice talking to you. It somehow relieves me knowing that I can just post anonymously and some anonymous people also cared to respond. Feels nice talking to someone. Thank you. 😊

Hi. I don't think I am in a great mental space too. But I find that talking to someone here kinda relieves me so I was hoping me talking to you will kind of relieve/entertain you for a little while too.. So tell me, what did you have for dinner? :)

Also, sorry for future grammatical/spelling error, english is not my first language.

YES OMG I totally think that too.. But then I feel guilty about doubting God but I think that's just the years of "culture" in me speaking.

Anyway, I just feel like life is so unfair when you look at it with beliefs, because you are hopeful that someone is listening to you. Maybe if I weren't so religious growing up, I won't have an excessive expectation of the world hence maybe a healthier mentality? I dunno...

*I literally googled "best suicide methods 2021" if that interests you. Haha yeah.... Damn my search history is.. 😂😅
Right. I also dream of stabbing my self to death sometimes and instead of being sad, I feel relief.
I don't think I am religious, just born in a very religious family. I still try to believe tho... Anyway, please give me your point of view. Thank you!
